### Fixed
- **The chart takes an `affinity`.** `values.schema.json` declared `affinity` as an object with no properties allowed, so every affinity a deployment set, a pod anti-affinity spreading two replicas over nodes for one, failed the install with `Additional property podAntiAffinity is not allowed`. The key now accepts any affinity, like `nodeSelector`. ([giantswarm/agent-platform#1080](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/issues/1080))
